global.locking_type.description: Locking type: 0=none, 1=local (file), 2=clustered (requires clvm), 3=unused (file-based, no locking), 4=none (no locking, unsafe)

global.use_lvmetad.description: Whether to use lvmetad (deprecated); recommended to use lvmpolld instead

global.use_lvmpolld.description: Whether to use lvmpolld for asynchronous metadata updates

global.wait_for_locks.description: Wait for locks to become available (instead of failing immediately) when acquiring locks

global.prioritise_write_locks.description: Prioritize write locks over read locks in contention

global.allocation_cache_max_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of the allocation cache for tracking used space

global.metadata_read_only.description: Whether to treat metadata as read-only (disables all write operations)

devices.global_filter.description: List of regular expressions filtering which devices (by device name or UUID) LVM scans for PVs

devices.scanning.scan_lvs.description: Whether to scan logical volumes for PV headers (rarely needed)

devices.scanning.md_component_detection.description: Whether to scan for MD (mdadm) component devices

devices.scanning.md_component_detection_.description: Timeout (in seconds) to wait for MD components to settle before scanning

devices.scanning.md_component_check.description: Perform additional checks for MD components (slower but safer)

devices.scanning.lvmetad_update_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) before lvmetad is updated after an LVM command

devices.scanning.lvmlockd_sock.description: Path to lvmlockd socket for clustered locking

devices.scanning.lvmlockd_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for lvmlockd operations; -1 means use default (5 seconds)

devices.scanning.lvmlockd_auto_unlock.description: Whether lvmlockd should auto-unlock when no volumes are active

devices.write_cache_state.description: Whether to persist cache state to disk for improved recovery

devices.sysfs_scan.description: Whether to scan sysfs for device information

devices.preferential_pvmove.description: When moving data, prefer moving to PVs with the same node affinity (useful with cluster
